articles.summary: Interface, Inc. (Nasdaq: TILE) announced today that it intends to release its third quarter 2026 results on Friday, November 6, 2026, prior to the open of the market. Interface will host a conference call the morning of Friday, November 6, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time, which will be simultaneously broadcast live over the internet. Laurel M. Hurd, Chief Executive Officer, and Bruce A. Hausmann, Chief Financial Officer, will host the call. Certain information discussed on the conference call will be available on Interface’s website, at https://investors.interface.com . articles.summary: Newest Styles Pair Premium Textile Looks with Unmatched Value and Short Lead Times Interface, Inc., the global flooring and sustainability leader, today introduced Twist Texture™, its latest carpet tile collection featuring seven textile-inspired styles. For designers managing fast-moving projects, the collection pairs sophisticated design with one affordable price point and three-week QuickShip availability. Its color palette of warm neutrals and subtle accents gives designers the flexibility to create calm, inviting spaces across a variety of commercial environments. Inspired by handcrafted textile traditions, Twist Texture translates woven textures, cross-hatched patterns, braided diagonals, and warm colorways into modular carpet tile for commercial interiors. Each style can be used in a range of applications, supporting everything from quiet, refined interiors to dynamic, collaborative zones, for workplaces, education environments, senior living spaces, and more.
articles.title: Interface Unveils Twist & Texture™ Carpet Tile Collection

articles.summary: Interface, Inc., the global flooring and sustainability leader, completed a pilot Social Life Cycle Assessment (S-LCA) of natural rubber used within select nora® rubber flooring products. The company is the first flooring manufacturer to publish an ISO-compliant S-LCA covering the life cycle of natural rubber production with one of its suppliers. The pilot helps build a broader understanding of product impact by exploring the people and communities connected to material production.
articles.title: Interface Completes Social Life Cycle Assessment of Natural Rubber​
